x: Congratulations to our old friends the "Poly" on their third place in the "Southern," ably helped by our own Poly member, Jimmy Wood, who was 23rd. Ron Hughes, who was with us during the war, was an excellent fifth and Rene Howell was 160th.
Hicks, and Ron Hughes, all English Internationals, our lads can be said to have run well in such company.
